usage: 運動場 (wan6 dung6 coeng4) refers to an outdoor or indoor area designated for playing sports.
It is commonly used to describe public or school sports facilities where people exercise or play games.
You can use 運動場 as the subject or object in a sentence, for example, '我哋去運動場跑步' (We go to the sports ground to run).
When talking about sports events or physical activities, this word helps specify the location.
It's often combined with verbs like 去 (go), 喺 (at), 鍛鍊 (exercise), or 打 (play).
